goal: Run automated tests on cross-compiled macOS arm64 binaries in CI
Prevent platform-specific runtime crashes and segfaults from going unnoticed
agreement: Concept support to test release-like cross-built macOS binaries natively (fanquake)
Open suggestion to use a workflow template instead of copy-pasting (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because cross-compiled macOS arm64 binaries are built in CI but never executed
It closes a major validation gap for release-like binaries on a supported platform

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it establishes native test coverage for macOS arm64 cross builds
It catches platform-specific test failures and segfaults directly in CI
